if ! getent group inventoryapi >/dev/null 2>&1; then addgroup -S inventoryapi; fi

  adduser -S -D -H -h /opt/inventory-api -s /sbin/nologin -G inventoryapi inventoryapi
fi
id inventoryapi

echo "== STEP 2: app dir + code =="
mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api
cat > /opt/inventory-api/app.py <<'PYEOF'
import json
import threading
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

LOCK = threading.Lock()
INVENTORY = {
    "widget": 100,
    "gadget": 42,
    "gizmo": 7,
}
START_TIME = time.time()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _send_json(self, code, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._send_json(200, {"status": "ok", "pid": __import__("os").getpid(), "uptime": time.time() - START_TIME})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            with LOCK:
                self._send_json(200, dict(INVENTORY))
        else:
            self._send_json(404, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

def main():
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
chown -R inventoryapi:inventoryapi /opt/inventory-api
chmod 755 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
echo "app.py written"
python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('/opt/inventory-api/app.py').read())" && echo "syntax OK"

echo "== STEP 3: OpenRC service with OOM protection =="
cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-api <<'INITEOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory-api"
description="Inventory API service (OOM-protected)"
command="/usr/bin/python3"
command_args="/opt/inventory-api/app.py"
command_user="inventoryapi:inventoryapi"
command_background="yes"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/inventory-api.log"
error_log="/var/log/inventory-api.log"

depend() {
	need net
	after firewall
}

start_post() {
	local pid tries
	pid=""
	tries=0
	while [ -z "${pid}" ] && [ "${tries}" -lt 20 ]; do
		pid="$(cat "${pidfile}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
		[ -n "${pid}" ] && [ -d "/proc/${pid}" ] && break
		pid=""
		tries=$((tries + 1))
		sleep 0.1
	done
	if [ -n "${pid}" ]; then
		echo -1000 > "/proc/${pid}/oom_score_adj" 2>/dev/null || true
		einfo "Set oom_score_adj=-1000 for inventory-api (pid ${pid})"
	else
		ewarn "Could not determine inventory-api pid to set oom_score_adj"
	fi
}
INITEOF

echo "== STEP 4: enable + start =="
rc-update add inventory-api default

sleep 1
